name: Sami Asks for Directions at the Gas Station
description: The Impala is parked at the fuel pumps. Sami leans out the window, holding a map in his hand, and speaks with the gas station attendant.
related_events: Sami consults map while speaking with station attendant

name: Daniel and the Crew Board a Mini-Van Taxi
description: Daniel and the crew approached a mini-van taxi and got inside. The vehicle remained stationary for a moment before pulling away from the curb, beginning to move through the streets.
related_events: Daniel and the crew enter a mini-van taxi

name: Approach the Door Amid Loud Music
description: The crew and Sophie walk toward a door. From behind it, the muffled sound of loud music pulses steadily, filling the air around them.
related_events: Crew and Sophie approach the door with music heard nearby

name: Daniel Forces the Lock and Enters the Building
description: Daniel uses a locksmith tool to pry the lock from the door. Once the lock is removed, he and the others go inside the building.
related_events: Daniel pries open the door lock with a locksmith tool
Daniel and others enter the building

name: The Group Realizes They Took a Wrong Turn
description: The Impala is stopped in a parking lot. Raymond says they might have gone the wrong way. Sami responds with sarcasm, saying, 'Oh, you think?' Marcel points out that the map said to go left. Julien replies that if you turned the map around, it would say to go right. Marcel laughs, amused by the comment.
related_events: Group realizes they took a wrong turn during navigation

name: Arrival in the Upscale Neighborhood
description: The Impala rolls to a stop along a quiet, tree-lined street bordered by expensive homes. The crew steps out, pausing briefly as Daniel turns to Raymond and tells him to park the car on the next street over. Raymond gets back into the Impala and drives away, while the rest of the crew remains behind, standing near the curb as the neighborhood sits still in the late afternoon light.
related_events: Crew exits Impala in upscale neighborhood
Daniel instructs Raymond to park on adjacent street

name: Julien Studies the Map During the Car Ride
description: The six of them are packed into the car as it moves down the street. Julien looks closely at a map, turning it slightly to catch the light from the window, his finger tracing a route while the others remain silent around him.
related_events: Group travels together in a car down the street
Julien studies a map during the car ride

name: Daniel, Julien, and Raymond Enter the Warehouse
description: Daniel walks down a narrow street with Julien and Raymond. He carries a cardboard tube as they move together. They reach a warehouse and go inside.
related_events: Daniel carries cardboard tube while walking with Julien and Raymond
Daniel, Julien, and Raymond enter a warehouse

name: Raymond Gayet Waits in a Peugeot Near the Champs Elysees
description: In a quiet street off the Champs Elysees, lined with large homes, a Peugeot sits parked. Inside, Raymond Gayet sits in the driver's seat, his hands gripping the wheel. The engine is off. He watches the street, his eyes shifting frequently, his posture tense. The glow of a streetlamp catches his face as he remains still, waiting.
related_events: Raymond Gayet waits nervously in a Peugeot in a Paris neighborhood

name: Driver Blocks Peugeot and Leaves
description: A Mercedes pulls up and parks directly in front of a Peugeot, stopping close enough to prevent the Peugeot from moving forward. The driver steps out of the Mercedes, closes the door, and walks away without looking back. The Peugeot remains stationary, now boxed in by the parked Mercedes and the vehicle behind it.
related_events: Mercedes driver parks and blocks Peugeot
Driver exits Mercedes and walks away

name: Marcel's Silent Arrival
description: Marcel enters the room where Wayne and Raymond are sitting. Wayne, looking impressed, asks Marcel what he said to them. Marcel replies dryly that he said nothing.
related_events: Marcel enters the room with Wayne and Raymond
Wayne asks Marcel what he said to them
Marcel responds that he said nothing

name: Raymond Notices Suspicious Activity at the Liquor Store
description: Raymond is checking out a Buick LaSabre when he notices the alarm light flashing on its dashboard. He stops and looks across the street, where an old Chevy Impala is parked with its engine running. Two men get out of the car and walk toward a liquor store.
related_events: Raymond notices a flashing alarm light on a Buick LaSabre
Raymond sees the old Chevy Impala across the street
Two men exit an old Chevy Impala and approach a liquor store

name: Julien Disables Alarms, Zero Confirms Entry
description: Julien moves through the dark room to the door, where he disables a second alarm panel. He continues down the hall and turns off the final alarm. Returning to the room, he gives a nod to Zero, who is sitting on the corner of the bed. Zero takes out his phone, dials a number, and speaks: 'We're in.'
related_events: Julien disables the second alarm panel
Julien deactivates the hall alarm
Zero waits on the corner of the bed
Zero signals successful entry by making a phone call

name: The Crew Departs for the Operation
description: The crew gathers in a room where a variety of gear—cell phones, electronic devices, and other equipment—lies spread across a table. Sami picks up several items and places them into a black canvas bag. A cell phone rings. Julien picks it up and speaks briefly. 'It's Raymond. He's outside with the car.' One by one, the crew members take their gear and head toward the door. As they move, Sophie leans in and kisses Sami on the cheek. Sami looks at her, momentarily surprised and slightly flustered. 'For luck,' she says.
related_events: Sami packs gear into black canvas bag
Julien answers incoming phone call from Raymond
Crew collects gear and moves toward exit
Sophie kisses Sami on the cheek for luck

name: Marcel Joins Daniel at the Limousine
description: Daniel and the others step out of the building carrying their suitcases. A limousine pulls up, and Marcel gets out. Bastaldi tells Daniel that Marcel will be accompanying him to the airport. Daniel reacts with surprise. Bastaldi explains that the move is necessary because he doesn't trust anyone, adding that Daniel is a thief by nature and that sending Marcel is a way to protect his investment.
related_events: Marcel exits limousine to join Daniel and group
Bastaldi announces Marcel will accompany Daniel to the airport
Daniel expresses shock at being accompanied
Bastaldi justifies decision by citing distrust and self-interest

name: Marcel Reacts to Raymond's Soaked Entrance
description: Raymond stepped into the room, soaked and dripping, his head bowed as he made his way to a chair and sat down. Marcel watched him, his expression hardening. He turned to Daniel, their eyes meeting briefly before Daniel gave a small, almost imperceptible nod. Without a word, Marcel stood and walked out of the room.
related_events: Raymond enters the room soaking wet and sits down in embarrassment
Marcel becomes angered by Raymond's appearance
Marcel and Daniel exchange a subtle nod
Marcel leaves the room after nodding to Daniel

name: Raphael and Hector Find the Car Missing
description: Raphael and Hector step out of a building and pull off their masks. Hector stops and looks around, confused. He asks Raphael where his car is. Raphael scans the street and realizes it's gone. He freezes, staring at the empty space. Hector grabs him and pulls him down the street, dragging him along as they move away.
related_events: Raphael and Hector remove their masks after exiting a building
Hector questions Raphael about the location of his car
Raphael realizes his car is missing from the street
Hector grabs and drags Raphael down the street

name: Daniel and Julien Try to Fix the Flashlight
description: In the darkness, Daniel whispered to Julien to turn on the flashlight. Julien pressed the switch, but nothing happened. He tried again, holding the device in both hands, but the light remained off. Daniel asked if the batteries were in. Julien hesitated, then asked if flashlights usually came with batteries. Daniel said they didn’t, and that Julien should have bought them. Julien replied that batteries weren’t on the list Daniel had given him. Daniel muttered that it should have been obvious, like buying a car without tires.
related_events: Daniel instructs Julien to turn on the flashlight
Julien attempts to turn on the non-functional flashlight
Julien questions whether flashlights come with batteries
Daniel expresses disbelief that Julien did not buy batteries
Julien defends his actions by referencing Daniel's shopping list
Daniel criticizes Julien for not anticipating the need for batteries

name: Zammito Leaves His Date for Mr. B
description: Zammito sits in a family-run Italian restaurant, the table covered in checkerboard cloth, candles flickering in Chianti bottles. Vic Damone sings 'Angela Mia' softly from the stereo. His cell phone rings. He answers. Half Tooth Tony's voice comes through, telling him Mr. B wants to see him. Zammito hesitates, glancing around as if expecting someone. He says he has a date with a woman he describes as a 'drop dead major babe.' Half Tooth Tony offers to pass on the message. Zammito pauses, then agrees to go. He stands, walks over to Mario, the restaurant owner, and tells him he has to leave immediately, asking Mario to tell his date an emergency came up. Mario nods and assures him it will be done.
related_events: Zammito receives a phone call from Half Tooth Tony
Half Tooth Tony instructs Zammito to meet Mr. B
Zammito decides to leave his date
Zammito informs restaurant owner Mario about his departure

name: Raymond Shows Off the Impala's Hydraulics
description: The crew steps out and walks toward the Impala, a lowrider with bright orange flames painted on the side, wire wheels, and chrome exhaust pipes. Sami remarks that he's glad Raymond didn't get something flashy. Raymond ignores the comment, presses a button, and the car's hydraulics activate, making it bounce up and down. Sami rolls his eyes as the others climb into the vehicle. Across the street, Lamar stands in the shadows with one of his friends, watching silently.
related_events: Crew approaches and enters the Impala
Sami expresses disapproval of flashy car choices
Raymond demonstrates the Impala's hydraulics by making it bounce

name: Lamar Watches from the Shadows
description: Across the street, Lamar stands in the shadows with one of his friends. They watch silently as the crew gathers around the Impala. Raymond presses a button, activating the hydraulics, and the car bounces up and down. Sami rolls his eyes. The others climb into the vehicle. Lamar does not move or speak, remaining still in the dark as the scene unfolds.
related_events: Lamar and his friend observe the crew from across the street

name: Raymond Confronts the Noisy Neighbors
description: The music from next door blares louder as the group enters the apartment, the bass vibrating through the walls. Wayne sits on the couch, unfazed, smoking a joint. Julien asks what the noise is, and Wayne replies that it’s just the neighbors, who do this regularly. Sami complains that the noise is making it impossible to think, and Zero wonders how anyone could sleep with the sound so loud. Sophie says she’s asked them over and over to keep it down, but they never listen. Raymond says he’ll go talk to them. Sophie and Wayne exchange amused glances, skeptical of his plan. Wayne mutters a sarcastic remark, and Sophie tells Raymond it’s not a good idea. Raymond insists it’s just a matter of communication, then gets up and leaves the apartment.
related_events: Loud music from neighbors disrupts the apartment
Sami expresses inability to concentrate due to noise
Zero questions how anyone can sleep with the noise
Sophie reveals repeated failed requests to lower the noise
Raymond offers to talk to noisy neighbors
Sophie and Wayne react skeptically to Raymond's offer
Raymond leaves the apartment to confront the neighbors

name: Julien climbs through a window to enter the building
description: Julien places a retractable ladder against the wall and climbs up. He pries open the window and climbs through. Zero follows him inside.
related_events: Julien places retractable ladder against wall
Julien climbs up retractable ladder
Julien pries open window
Julien climbs through window

name: Zero Follows Julien Through the Window
description: Julien pries open the window and climbs inside the building. Zero climbs in after him.
related_events: Zero follows Julien into building

name: Raphael Confronts Hector and Orders Him to Fetch Beer
description: Raphael sits on the couch, jaw clenched, his face tight with anger. He looks up at Hector, who is sitting across from him with several other gang members. When Hector suggests calling the police, Raphael snaps, cutting him off mid-sentence. He mocks Hector, telling him not to think because he’s not good at it. The other gang members laugh. Raphael then orders Hector to get beers for the group. Hector leaves the room without a word. Raphael stares ahead, his expression hardening.
related_events: Raphael expresses anger toward Hector
Gang Bangers laugh at Hector
Raphael orders Hector to get beers

name: Raphael Sends Hector Away and Threatens Revenge
description: Raphael sits on the couch, jaw clenched, his anger barely contained. He looks up slowly as Hector sits across from him with a group of gang members. After Hector suggests calling the police, Raphael snaps at him, mocking his intelligence. The others laugh. Raphael orders Hector to get beers for the group. Hector leaves the room. Once he is gone, Raphael's expression hardens. He declares that when he finds the person responsible for the theft, he will kill them and mount their head on his dashboard.
related_events: Hector leaves the room after being ridiculed
Raphael threatens violent revenge

name: Marcel Confronts the Biker at the Door
description: Marcel walks along the side of the building and pulls two black leather gloves from his jacket pocket. He puts them on as he approaches the door and knocks. The Biker opens the door and begins to speak, but Marcel head butts him, driving his forehead into the bridge of the Biker's nose. The Biker clutches his face, blood streaming from his nose, and Marcel grabs him by the hair, delivering several rapid punches to his face that force him backward into the room.
related_events: Marcel puts on black leather gloves before approaching the door
Marcel knocks on the door and is confronted by the Biker

name: Marcel Attacks the Biker at the Door
description: Marcel steps up to the door and head butts the Biker, striking him in the face and causing his nose to bleed. The Biker brings his hands to his face. Marcel grabs him by the hair and delivers several quick punches to his face, driving him backward into the room.
related_events: Marcel head butts the Biker causing nasal injury
Marcel grabs the Biker by the hair and delivers multiple facial punches

name: Raymond Confronts the Biker at the Noisy Door
description: Raymond walks toward a door at the end of the building where loud music is playing. He knocks and waits. The door opens, revealing a large man in a leather jacket with a full beard and several earrings. The man holds a beer bottle and stands in the doorway, with two other rough-looking men visible behind him. Raymond, speaking cheerfully and loudly over the music, says, 'Hello. My name is Raymond. I am visiting next door and I was wondering if you could make your music a little less loud.' The biker takes a sip of his beer, then pours it over Raymond's head. 'Fuck off!' he says, and slams the door.
related_events: Raymond approaches the door at the end of the building
Raymond knocks on the door and is greeted by a biker

name: Raymond Asks to Lower the Music and Is Rejected
description: Raymond walks up to a door at the end of the building where loud music is playing. He knocks and waits. The door opens to reveal a large biker in a leather jacket, with a full beard and several earrings, holding a beer bottle. Two other rough-looking men stand behind him. Raymond, speaking cheerfully and loudly over the music, says, 'Hello. My name is Raymond. I am visiting next door and I was wondering if you could make your music a little less loud.' The biker takes a sip of his beer, says, 'No,' and before Raymond can respond, pours the beer over his head. Then he says, 'Fuck off!' and slams the door shut.
related_events: Raymond requests the music to be turned down
Biker refuses Raymond's request and pours beer on him
Biker slams the door in Raymond's face

name: Daniel and Julien Confront Raymond During the Getaway Drive
description: Raymond bites his lip nervously as he drives. Julien watches, finding the tension amusing. Daniel leans forward and asks Raymond what makes a good getaway driver, then answers his own question with quiet intensity: being able to get away. Raymond responds that Daniel is always pointing out his flaws, adding that his analyst recommends positive reinforcement instead. Julien replies with mock approval, saying they’d like to commend Raymond on how well he fucked up tonight.
related_events: Raymond bites his lip nervously while driving
Julien finds Raymond's nervousness amusing
Raymond complains about Daniel's negative feedback
Julien sarcastically commends Raymond for failing

name: Julien Amused by Raymond's Nervous Driving
description: Raymond bites his lip as he drives, his hands tight on the wheel. Julien watches him with a smirk, finding his anxiety funny. Daniel leans forward from the back seat, his voice calm but edged with irritation as he speaks to Raymond.
related_events: Julien finds Raymond's nervousness amusing

name: Marcel and the Crew Seek Entry to Sophie's Door
description: Marcel knocks on the door. A peephole slides open as an eye appears, scanning the group. Marcel speaks, saying they are looking for Sophie and that Laurant sent them. The door opens, revealing Sophie, a woman in her late twenties. Sami murmurs, 'Ouh La La,' under his breath.
related_events: Marcel knocks on the door to request entry
Occupant observes the crew through the peephole
Marcel states their purpose and reference to Laurant
Sophie opens the door and greets the crew

name: Sami Reacts to Sophie Opening the Door
description: Sophie opens the door. Sami looks at her and softly says, 'Ouh La La.'
related_events: Sami expresses quiet admiration for Sophie

name: Julien Disables the Alarm
description: Julien attaches a device to the alarm panel. Numbers flash rapidly on the screen as the device works, then gradually stop, one by one, until only the final code remains. Julien inputs the sequence into the keypad. The alarm disarms. He nods silently to the others.
related_events: Julien attaches device to alarm panel
Computer cracks alarm code
Julien enters alarm code

name: Julien and Zero Move to the Side of the House
description: Julien enters the code on the alarm panel and the system powers down. He signals to Zero, and the two of them move quietly along the side of the house. Daniel, Sami, and Marcel stay back, remaining still in the shadows near their original position.
related_events: Julien and Zero move to side of house
Daniel, Sami and Marcel wait in shadows

name: Daniel and Julien Flee to the Car
description: Daniel and Julien run toward the street. Daniel shouts at Raymond to start the car. Raymond turns the key and the engine roars to life. Daniel and Julien dash across the street and climb into the back seat.
related_events: Daniel and Julien run toward the street
Daniel urgently instructs Raymond to start the car
Raymond starts the car engine
Daniel and Julien rush across the street and enter the back seat

name: Raymond Struggles to Drive the Peugeot Out of a Tight Spot
description: Raymond starts the engine and tries to pull the Peugeot out of a narrow space between parked cars. With only a few inches of clearance in front and behind, the car lurches forward and backward, jerking rapidly like a pinball caught between bumpers, unable to break free.
related_events: Raymond attempts to maneuver the car out of a tight parking space
Peugeot jerks rapidly in tight space like a pinball

name: Sami's Failed Escape from Marcel
description: Sami sees Marcel enter the bar and immediately runs toward the back. As he tries to get away, one of Marcel's men stands in his path, blocking him. Sami turns around just as Marcel approaches, forcing a smile.
related_events: Sami sees Marcel enter the bar and runs towards the back
Sami encounters one of Marcel's men blocking his path
Sami turns around and forces a smile as Marcel approaches

name: Marcel Confronts Sami at the Bar
description: Marcel enters the bar and spots Sami, who immediately turns and tries to flee toward the back. One of Marcel's men blocks Sami's path, forcing him to stop. As Marcel approaches, Sami turns around and forces a smile. Marcel asks if he's going somewhere. Sami replies that he thought Marcel was someone else and says he wouldn't have run if he'd known it was him. Marcel stands silently, staring at Sami without speaking. Sami then says Marcel is probably there for the money he owes, and when Marcel nods, Sami admits he doesn't have it. Marcel opens the bathroom door and shoves Sami inside.
related_events: Marcel questions Sami about leaving
Sami admits he thought Marcel was someone else and apologizes
Marcel glares at Sami in silence
Sami admits he owes Marcel money but cannot pay
Marcel pushes Sami into the bathroom

name: Frankie Zammito Confronts Vinny Over Unpaid Loan
description: Vinny kneels on the ground, apologizing to Frankie Zammito. He rises and takes a step toward him. Zammito warns him not to get blood on him, and Vinny stops. Zammito demands to know if he didn’t warned Vinny not to take the money, reminding him that he refused the loan at first. Joey 'Two Tons' confirms that Zammito had told Vinny not to do it. Zammito points out that three weeks have passed and no payment has been made, and says it makes him look weak on the street if he doesn’t act.
related_events: Vinny apologizes to Frankie Zammito while on his knees
Vinny rises from his knees and approaches Frankie Zammito
Frankie Zammito threatens Vinny over potential bloodstain
Frankie Zammito confronts Vinny about ignoring loan advice
Joey 'Two Tons' confirms Zammito's prior warning to Vinny

name: Break His Arm
description: Frankie Zammito stood facing Vinny, his voice sharp and cold. Vinny, still shaken, tried to speak, but Zammito cut him off. 'Shut up! Don't you try to make me feel bad about this.' He turned to Joey, who nodded in confirmation—Zammito had warned Vinny not to take the money. Now, three weeks late on the payment, Zammito demanded consequence. 'Break his arm,' he said. Vinny looked up, desperate. 'Jesus, Frankie, I'm your brother!' Zammito didn't flinch. 'That's why we're only breaking one arm.' Joey and Nicky moved in.
related_events: Frankie Zammito expresses anger over unpaid debt and damaged reputation
Frankie Zammito orders Joey and Nicky to break Vinny's arm
Vinny pleads with Frankie Zammito for mercy

name: Marcel Subdues Biker #2 in Close Combat
description: As the Biker fell backward through the glass coffee table, Biker #2 moved in behind Marcel and threw a hard punch. Marcel turned just in time, lowering his head so that the punch struck the crown of his skull, leaving Biker #2 clutching his broken knuckles in pain. Marcel responded with a sharp knee to the groin, doubling the man over. As Biker #2 turned to his side, Marcel delivered a kick to the back of his knee, spinning him around and forcing him down onto his knees. In one fluid motion, Marcel drove an elbow into the back of the man’s head. Biker #2 collapsed face forward, motionless. The third Biker, standing near the stereo, switched off the power. The room fell silent.
related_events: Biker #2 attacks Marcel from behind with a punch
Marcel dodges punch causing attacker to injure knuckles on skull
Marcel knees Biker #2 in the groin
Marcel kicks Biker #2 behind the knee to spin him down
Marcel elbows Biker #2 in the back of the head

name: Third Biker Submits After Marcel's Counterattack
description: After Marcel knocked Biker #2 unconscious with a series of swift strikes, the third Biker, standing near the stereo, turned off the power. The room fell silent.
related_events: Third Biker turns off the stereo power

name: First Biker Defeated by Punch and Fall
description: The Biker is hit by a final punch, stumbles backward, and crashes through a large glass coffee table, landing in a heap amidst the shattered glass.
related_events: Biker falls through glass coffee table after final punch

name: Sami Confronts Marcel About Rumors and Is Attacked
description: Sami tells Marcel that their close encounter could start rumors. Without responding, Marcel punches Sami in the stomach, causing him to drop to his knees. The door to the bathroom opens and a large man looks inside, pausing awkwardly at the scene. Sami gasps, 'Told you.' Marcel slams the door shut, then grabs Sami by the ear and pulls him to his feet.
related_events: Sami accuses Marcel of starting rumors
Marcel punches Sami in the stomach

name: Marcel Slams the Door and Forces Sami Up
description: The door to the bathroom opens, and the Large Man peers inside, pausing as he takes in the scene. Marcel slams the door shut, then grabs Sami by the ear and yanks him to his feet.
related_events: Large Man interrupts and observes the scene
Marcel slams door and drags Sami to his feet

name: Marcel Offers Sami a Job in Chicago with a Threat
description: Marcel punches Sami in the stomach, causing him to drop to his knees. The door to the bathroom opens, and a large man looks in, pausing awkwardly at the scene before retreating as Marcel slams the door shut. Marcel grabs Sami by the ear and pulls him to his feet. He tells Sami that instead of breaking his fingers, he is giving him a chance to repay what he owes by joining a group going to Chicago for a job. Sami hesitates, mentioning he has legal issues in the United States, but quickly agrees when Marcel gives him a hard look. Marcel warns him that if he tries to leave town, he will find out, and if Sami manages to leave, he will still track him down and cut him into little pieces the next time they meet in a bathroom. He hands Sami a piece of paper and tells him to be at the address written on it by nine o'clock the next morning.
related_events: Marcel offers Sami a chance to repay debt through a job
Marcel threatens Sami with violence if he flees
Marcel gives Sami a piece of paper with instructions
Marcel instructs Sami to appear at an address tomorrow morning

name: Julien Tries to Order Alcohol at a Dry Diner
description: Julien asks the waitress for a wine list. She smirks and tells him they don’t have one. Sophie adds that they don’t serve wine. Julien then requests a beer, but Sami confirms the restaurant does not serve alcohol. The waitress lists the available drinks: iced tea, lemonade, Coca-Cola, Sprite, or root beer. Julien asks what root beer is. Daniel interrupts and orders Sprite for everyone. The waitress responds with mock relief, saying they’ve finally finished choosing drinks.
related_events: Waitress informs Julien that the restaurant does not have a wine list
Sami clarifies that the restaurant does not serve wine
Julien requests a beer after learning wine is unavailable
Waitress lists non-alcoholic beverage options to Julien
Daniel orders Sprite for the group
Waitress sarcastically acknowledges completion of beverage selection

name: Waitress Stops Zero from Smoking
description: Zero grins and puts a cigarette in his mouth. The waitress quickly approaches and pulls it out. Zero, startled, mutters in French, 'No smoking? No drinking? What kind of country is this?'
related_events: Waitress removes cigarette from Zero's mouth
Zero expresses disbelief about no smoking and no drinking

name: Vinny Is Punched in the Face
description: A man's head snaps back as someone punches him in the face. Blood flows from his nose. The scene shifts abruptly to a new location and context.
related_events: Someone punches Vinny in the face

name: Julien Lights the Lighter and the Old Man Commands Them to Stop
description: Daniel and Julien stand in complete darkness. Daniel tells Julien to light his lighter because he can't see. Julien pulls out the lighter and ignites it. The flame flares up, suddenly illuminating the entire room. Julien looks at the flame, transfixed. From the top of the stairs, an old man in a bathrobe appears, pale and frail, holding a long double-barrel shotgun. He shouts, 'Don't move!' Daniel and Julien turn toward him, frozen in place.
related_events: Julien lights a lighter in the dark room
Julien stares at the lighter flame in amazement
Old man commands intruders to stop with a shotgun

name: Daniel and Julien React to the Old Man's Fall
description: The old man lost his balance and tumbled head over heels down the stairs, landing motionless on the floor. Daniel and Julien stared at him in shock. Julien asked if he was dead. Daniel said he didn't know, adding that the man looked dead. Julien replied that the man had looked dead even before the fall. After a moment, the old man groaned, opened his eyes, and grabbed his shotgun. Startled, Daniel and Julien immediately ran toward the door.
related_events: Old man loses balance and tumbles down the stairs
Daniel and Julien react to the old man's fall with shock

name: Daniel and Julien Flee After the Old Man Wakes
description: The old man groaned, opened his eyes, and reached for his shotgun. Daniel and Julien turned and ran toward the door.
related_events: Old man regains consciousness and grabs his shotgun
Daniel and Julien flee toward the door after the old man stirs

name: Zero and Marcel's Radio Battle
description: Zero turns on the radio and flips through stations until he finds Renaud singing 'Des que le vent soufflera.' He leans back, nodding to the music. Marcel reaches over and changes the station to Johnny Hallyday's 'Que je t'aime.' Zero pushes the button to switch back to Renaud. Marcel responds by switching it back to Hallyday. They keep pressing the button, alternating between the two songs. Bastaldi finally snaps. 'Stop it! Both of you!' He turns off the radio. A silence follows. Marcel, after a moment, begins to hum quietly, 'Que je t'aime... que je...' Zero stares at him. Bastaldi glares. Marcel stops.
related_events: Zero turns on the radio and selects a Renaud song
Marcel changes the radio station to Johnny Hallyday
Zero and Marcel engage in a radio station conflict

name: Bastaldi Stops the Radio Argument
description: As Zero and Marcel kept switching the radio back and forth between Renaud and Hallyday, Bastaldi suddenly shouted for them to stop. He reached over and turned off the radio. The limo fell silent. After a moment, Marcel began quietly singing 'Que je t'aime' under his breath, just loud enough for Zero to hear. When he noticed Bastaldi staring at him, he stopped.
related_events: Bastaldi orders Marcel and Zero to stop fighting over the radio
Bastaldi turns off the radio to end the conflict

name: Marcel Sings Despite the Silence
description: After Bastaldi turns off the radio, Marcel begins to sing quietly to himself, the words of Johnny Hallyday's song just loud enough to be heard. Zero listens, tense and watchful. The singing continues for a few lines until Bastaldi turns and fixes Marcel with a sharp glare. Marcel falls silent.
related_events: Marcel quietly sings Johnny Hallyday song to provoke Zero
Marcel stops singing after being glared at by Bastaldi

name: Julien and Sami in the Limo
description: Julien pours himself a drink. Sami plays with the air conditioner.
related_events: Julien pours himself a drink in the limo
Sami plays with the air conditioner in the limo

name: The Team Plans the Break-In
description: Sophie sketches a diagram of the house on a napkin and points out the security systems: an exterior alarm, a motion detector in the hall leading to the bedroom, and the control panel located inside the bedroom. Julien says he can handle the exterior alarm but notes the bedroom system will be difficult. Sami suggests that after disabling the outside alarm, they enter through the bedroom window. Daniel approves the idea and assigns Zero and Julien to go in through the window to disable the motion detector, while the others will enter through the front door. Sophie offers her car, but Daniel refuses, saying it’s too risky if someone records the license plate. Raymond agrees to steal a car instead. When Sami asks when they’ll go, Sophie says tonight, explaining the occupants won’t be home. Daniel expresses surprise at the timing, but Sophie insists it’s the best opportunity. Sami mutters about jet lag, and Daniel tells him to take a nap.
related_events: Sophie explains security system layout
Julien assesses exterior alarm feasibility
Sami proposes entry through bedroom window

name: Arranging a Getaway Car
description: Sophie offered her car for the job, but Daniel immediately objected, pointing out that if someone caught the license plate, it would lead straight back to her. Instead, he turned to Raymond and told him to steal a vehicle. Raymond nodded and said it wouldn’t be a problem.

Raymond agrees to steal a vehicle

name: Setting the Heist for Tonight
description: Sami asked when they would carry out the operation, mentioning his jet lag. Daniel reacted with surprise when Sophie said it would happen immediately. Sophie confirmed the plan: they would go tonight, while the occupants were away. She had already sketched a diagram of the house on a napkin. She told Sami to take a nap to rest before the job.

Daniel expresses surprise at immediate timing

Sophie tells Sami to take a nap

name: Daniel and Julien Steal the Painting
description: In the dark apartment, Daniel Foray lights his Zippo lighter, casting a small glow around the room. He places the lighter on a small table and moves to a painting on the wall. Using a pen knife, he cuts the canvas from its frame and carefully rolls it up. He signals it is time to go.
related_events: Daniel Foray lights his Zippo lighter in the dark apartment
Daniel Foray cuts a painting from its frame
Daniel Foray rolls up the cut canvas

name: Julien Ignites the Fire
description: Daniel placed the Zippo lighter on the small table and moved to the painting on the wall. Julien reached for the lighter, ignoring Daniel's warning. The moment he touched it, the flame burned his hand. He jerked back and flung the lighter. It flew across the room and landed in the corner, where it set the curtains ablaze.

Julien Labesse burns his hand on the Zippo lighter
Zippo lighter ignites the curtains causing a fire

name: Julien Tries to Put Out the Fire and Burns the Painting
description: Julien grabs the canvas from Daniel and starts beating the burning curtains with it, swinging his arms wildly. The flames from the curtains briefly subside, but the canvas catches fire during the struggle. He doesn't notice at first, still swinging the burning painting. After a moment, he sees the flames on the canvas and stops, putting them out. Daniel stares at him in silence. He unrolls the painting and finds it ruined.

name: Sophie Offers Sleeping Bags to Unexpected Guests
description: Sophie looks around as the group arrives, taken aback by how many there are. She tells them she wasn’t expecting so many. From a closet, she pulls out a few sleeping bags and offers them to the group. Sami thanks her as he takes one.

Sami acknowledges receipt of sleeping bags

name: Raymond Meets Wayne
description: Sophie introduced Wayne to the group, gesturing toward him as he sat on the couch. Raymond walked over, extended his hand, and said, 'I am Raymond. Thank you for allowing us to stay here.' Wayne looked up, nodded, and replied, 'No problem, man,' before offering Raymond the bong. Raymond declined politely. He then turned his attention to the television, where a cartoon was playing. 'Oh, Pepe Le Pew. He is very funny and quite well known in France,' Raymond said. Wayne responded, 'Yeah, I dig him.' Raymond added, 'Although a cartoon, I feel he shares a universal theme: We are all searching for love. No?' Wayne stared blankly for a moment, then said, 'Whoa... That's deep.' Sophie asked the group, 'You guys hungry?'
related_events: Sophie introduces Wayne to the group

Raymond thanks Wayne for allowing the group to stay

He then turns his attention to the television, where a cartoon is playing. Recognizing the character, he says it is Pepe Le Pew, a well-known and funny cartoon in France. He adds that the cartoon touches on a universal theme—that everyone is searching for love. Wayne stares at him silently, his expression blank as he processes the words. After a pause, he says, 'Whoa... That's deep.' Sophie interrupts, asking if anyone is hungry.

name: Robbery Begins at the Counter
description: Two masked men burst into the store, brandishing guns, and rush to the counter. One of them, Raphael, demands money from the old man behind the counter. The old man opens the cash register and hands over the bills without resistance.

Old man opens cash register and hands over bills

Raphael strikes him with the gun and pulls him partway over the counter, pressing the gun to his head. The old man pleads that he does not have the combination. Raphael shoves him to the floor and runs out of the store with the other men.
related_events: Raphael demands safe to be opened
Old man claims he does not have safe combination
Old man pleads he does not have safe combination

name: Sami Steals a Man's Wallet in the Plaza
description: Sami Zerhouni moves through a crowded plaza filled with tourists. He spots a man about to take a photograph, distracted and unaware. Sami slips close, deftly removes the man's wallet, and continues walking without breaking stride. The wallet is gone before the man notices anything.
related_events: Sami Zerhouni steals a man's wallet in the plaza

name: Sami's Failed Pickpocket Attempt
description: Sami Zerhouni approached a woman with an unzipped purse and slipped his hand inside. As he did, the woman zipped the bag closed, catching the hair on his arm. She turned, saw his hand, and yanked the purse away, ripping the hair from his skin. She swung the bag at him with force, striking him in the face. Sami fell backward onto the ground, where wallets and billfolds spilled from his pockets. He struggled to his feet and began gathering the items as two police officers appeared across the plaza. He fled into the crowd.
related_events: Sami Zerhouni attempts to steal from an unzipped purse
Sami Zerhouni's arm hair is caught and ripped by a woman's purse zipper

name: Sami Caught and Attacked by Victim

It strikes him in the face, knocking him to the ground. Wallets and billfolds spill from his pockets. He struggles to his feet and begins gathering the scattered items when he notices two police officers approaching across the plaza. He flees into the crowd.

He pushed himself up and began gathering them when he spotted two police officers moving toward him through the plaza. He dropped the wallets, turned, and ran, weaving into the crowd until he disappeared.

Daniel looks out his window and sees the old man running out of his house, holding a shotgun and heading straight toward the vehicle. name: Raymond Breaks Free Under Fire
description: Daniel shouted at Raymond to get them out of there. Raymond raised himself up and grabbed the wheel, his hands moving quickly. The old man was crouched by the side of his house, prying open the breach of his shotgun to reload. Raymond pressed hard on the accelerator, the Peugeot’s engine roaring as the wheels spun against the pavement. He held the brake with his other foot, the car trembling in place. Then he turned the wheel sharply to the left and released the brake. The car lunged forward, crashing into the rear of the Mercedes parked behind, shoving it out into the street as the Peugeot followed in a burst of motion.

description: The Peugeot lurches forward as Raymond releases the brake and turns the wheel sharply to the left. The car surges ahead, smashing into the rear of the Mercedes and shoving it out into the street. Glass litters the pavement as the vehicles collide, the force of the impact jolting both cars. The engine roars as the Peugeot gains momentum, finally breaking free from its stalled position.

name: Zammito Confronts Bobby Beans About Warehouse Interest
description: Bobby Beans enters Zammito's office, greets him with a cheek kiss, and exchanges pleasantries. Zammito offers him a drink or coffee, mentioning a new shipment of espresso from Sicily, but Bobby declines. Bobby states his interest in the warehouse on Merchant Street, explaining that his import business has seen a significant increase in volume and that the proceeds this quarter will be supernumerary. Zammito interrupts, asking what 'supernumerary' means. Bobby explains it means better than expected. Zammito scoffs and tells him to use plain language. Bobby says he’s taking a vocabulary course to improve his communication skills. Zammito presses him on the offer, asking how much they’re willing to pay. Bobby clarifies he’s not there to negotiate, only to express interest. Zammito dismisses the visit, telling Bobby to return with a real offer when his people are serious. Bobby says he’ll report the conversation to Mr. Maranzano. Zammito waves him off. After Bobby leaves, Zammito calls him a jerk-wad.

Zammito expressed frustration, saying he had wanted a clean break. Joey 'Two Tons' responded that it wasn't an exact science. Zammito then told them to send flowers—roses or carnations—and a get well soon card. Nicky got up to carry out the order. Zammito added that they should also send a case of steaks to his brother's house so the kids wouldn't go hungry while he recovered.

name: Sami Takes the Bag
description: Sami sits with a black canvas bag, pulling out a pair of shoes and setting them aside. Sophie approaches and asks if he likes shoes. He tells her he likes the bag and thinks it would be good for the job that night. She says it belongs to Vincent Bastaldi and that he probably wouldn’t mind if Sami used it. He unzips the bag, turns it upside down, and dumps the rest of the shoes onto the floor.

description: Sami watches as Sophie joins him while he sorts through a black canvas bag filled with shoes. He asks how she started working for the Bastaldis. Sophie explains she needed money to pay rent because the art world hasn’t recognized her talent yet, and that Laurant and Vincent pay well for information. Sami asks if she arranged for the people she worked for to be robbed. Sophie replies that they weren’t nice people.

Sophie reveals her employment with the Bastaldi family
Sophie justifies targeting her former employers

name: Sami's Tattoo and the Story Behind It
description: Sophie notices a faded tattoo of the name 'Casandra' on Sami's arm and runs her finger over the letters. She asks if it was an old girlfriend, and Sami replies, 'Something like that.' When she presses further, asking if the woman broke his heart, Sami grows quiet and tells her he got the tattoo in prison. He served three years, and when he got out, she was married to his best friend. Sophie apologizes, saying she didn’t mean to pry. Sami says it’s okay, that it was a long time ago. The conversation ends there, and Sophie walks away with a smile after mentioning she’s thinking of getting a tattoo of a flower on her ass.

Sami reveals the tattoo was gotten in prison

Sami reacts quizzically to Sophie's tattoo idea
Sophie flirts with Sami and walks away

name: Julien and Zero Play Cards in the Background
description: While Sami and Sophie talk near a black canvas bag filled with shoes, Julien and Zero remain at the back of the room, focused on a game of cards. They do not join the conversation or look up as Sami empties the bag and Sophie traces the tattoo on his arm. Their hands move steadily over the cards, dealing, shuffling, and playing without pause.

name: Raymond's Phone Call with His Mother
description: Raymond stands at the pay phone by the bar, speaking in French to his mother. He tells her he has his vitamins, that he has everything he needs, and assures her he will be coming back. He explains he’s only going to be gone a few days and promises to call when he arrives. He tries to end the call, telling her he has to go, but listens as she continues speaking. He insists he’s not yelling, then hangs up after a final attempt to say goodbye.

name: Sami Arrives and Introduces Himself
description: Sami enters the bar and walks over to Daniel and Julien. He tells them his name and says Marcel sent him. Julien asks what he does, and Sami replies that he’s done a bit of everything—boosted cars, stolen radios, run scams, and is currently into pick-pocketing. He laughs at his own joke, but the others don’t react. Daniel introduces Zero, who has just entered and stands quietly in a leather jacket, his gaze fixed on Sami. Sami greets him with a joke, calling himself 'one' and pointing to the others as 'two, three, four, and five,' but the humor falls flat. Julien puts an arm around Sami and leads him away, warning him to keep quiet and not provoke Zero.
related_events: Sami introduces himself to Daniel and Julien

name: Zero Arrives at the Bar
description: Zero enters the bar and walks in with a casual nod to Daniel. He fixes a steady, intense stare on Sami, who is standing nearby. Daniel introduces him, saying, 'This is Zero.' Sami greets him with a joke, saying, 'Hi. I'm one and this is two, three, four and five,' but no one laughs. The others react with discomfort, and Sami quickly senses the tension. Julien steps in, putting an arm around Sami and guiding him away. Zero speaks in French, asking about the plan to go to America, and switches to English when reminded Sami doesn't understand. He shows little interest in Sami’s background and cuts him off mid-sentence. When told no one may be killed, Zero appears confused, pressing Daniel on why he was brought if there’s no one to kill.
related_events: Zero enters the bar and is introduced to Sami

name: Julien Warns Sami About Zero
description: After Sami makes a joke that falls flat, Julien puts his arm around him and leads him away from Daniel, Zero, and Raymond. They step aside, out of earshot of the others. Julien looks at Sami and tells him not to provoke Zero, warning that he is dangerous and might kill someone just for the offense. Sami listens as Julien advises him to stay quiet and follow orders.
related_events: Julien warns Sami about Zero's dangerous nature

name: Zero Questions Sami About His Language and Background
description: Zero asks Sami why he doesn’t speak French, given that he is from Algeria. Sami begins to explain that not all Algerians speak French, depending on the school they attended, and that he never really learned it. Zero interrupts, saying he is not interested in Sami’s life story. Sami then turns to Raymond and quietly remarks that Zero speaks about himself in the third person. Raymond responds by suggesting Sami correct him if he wants.
related_events: Sami clarifies his lack of French language background to Zero
Sami comments on Zero's third-person speech habit to Raymond

name: Zero Questions His Role
description: Zero asks Daniel in English if they are going to America. Daniel confirms, but reminds him that Sami doesn't speak French. Zero then asks Sami where he is from. Sami says Algeria. When Zero questions why Sami doesn't speak French, Sami begins to explain his schooling, but Zero cuts him off, saying he is not interested in his life story. Turning back to Daniel, Zero asks who is going to be killed. Daniel replies that hopefully no one will be killed. Zero looks confused and asks, 'No one?' He then questions why he is there. Daniel explains that Zero is only there in case trouble happens. Zero presses further, asking if he can kill someone if there is trouble. Daniel hesitates, saying they'll see.

Zero requests permission to kill if trouble occurs
Daniel instructs Zero to serve as a contingency for trouble

The group arrives in a dangerous industrial area, is abandoned by their taxi driver, and immediately surrounded by a gang led by Lamar, who approaches from both front and rear, establishing a threatening confrontation.

name: Sami's Greeting, Julien's Joke, and Raymond's Plea
description: Sami stepped forward and raised his hand as if to greet Lamar. Lamar snapped at him, refusing the gesture. Julien, standing nearby, quipped that the bags contained dirty underwear. Lamar forced a laugh but pressed on, demanding the suitcases. Raymond moved in, placing a hand on Lamar's arm, and told him that violence wasn't the answer, urging him to find another way to deal with his anger. Lamar shouted at Raymond to get out of his face, pulled out a knife, and his gang revealed clubs, chains, and pipes. Zero, still sitting on a suitcase, called out in defiance, telling Lamar to go fuck himself. Daniel translated. Zero continued, saying they were tired of the nonsense and warned Lamar to put the knife away before he shoved it up his ass. Lamar, startled, demanded to know who Zero was. Julien simply pointed at him. When Lamar challenged Zero to take the knife, Zero stood, pulled out a 9mm Glock, and aimed it at Lamar's head. The gang fled. Zero shifted the aim to Lamar's groin and told him to leave before he shot off his balls. Lamar ran. The others picked up their bags and walked toward a building. Zero followed, leaving Sami behind, who stared after him in disbelief and accused him of smuggling a loaded gun through customs. Zero replied that he had put it in Sami's bag, then grinned and walked away.

name: Zammito Meets Bonanno to Discuss a Rival's Move
description: Zammito enters the room where Angelo Bonanno sits, smoking a cigar and sipping brandy. Bonanno greets him warmly and gestures toward the couch. Zammito sits and reports that Bobby Beans visited him earlier that day, bringing word that Maranzano is interested in buying the Merchant Street warehouse. Bonanno listens, then says Maranzano is trying to gain a foothold in their territory. Zammito replies that if Maranzano pushes further, they’ll stop him. Bonanno comments that business must be good for Maranzano to be buying property, and Zammito adds that he heard Maranzano’s profits this quarter are supernumerary. Bonanno stares at him, unsure of the word, and Zammito explains it means better than expected. Bonanno calls it a good word just as Half Tooth Tony enters to remind Bonanno of an appointment in ten minutes. After Tony leaves, Bonanno reveals the 'appointment' is just Judge Judy starting on TV and invites Zammito to stay and watch. Zammito declines, saying he’s tired and wants to go home. Bonanno affectionately slaps his cheeks and tells him to rest. As Zammito heads out, Bonanno asks about Zammito’s brother missing three weeks. Zammito confirms it, saying Joey 'Two Tons' and Nicky 'The Rake' carried out the job. Bonanno presses whether Zammito was there. Zammito replies that they live and die by the rules they make, that they are men of honor, and that honor without respect is like a horseless carriage. Bonanno pauses, then asks what the hell that means.

Raymond corrects him, saying the Black Panthers were a 1960s militant group and that Marcel likely means The Pink Panther. Marcel dismisses the correction and snaps at Raymond, telling him no one asked for his input and calling him a 'little turd.' Raymond responds calmly, saying there's no need for abuse and that Marcel is projecting his anger. Marcel retorts with a crude insult. name: Daniel Delivers the Painting to Bastaldi
description: Daniel, Julien, and Raymond enter the room and approach two large desks facing each other. One desk is empty; the other is occupied by Laurant Bastaldi, who sits with a no-nonsense demeanor. Marcel Burot stands off to the side, watching. As Daniel passes, Marcel remarks that he almost got his ass blown off the previous night, calling him a 'black panther.' Raymond corrects him, saying he means 'Pink Panther,' but Marcel dismisses the correction and insults Raymond. Raymond responds calmly, suggesting open and honest communication, which only provokes Marcel further. Bastaldi silences them both, annoyed. A muffled groaning sound comes from the background. Daniel asks where Bastaldi’s brother is. Bastaldi replies that Vincent is in the States on business, then gestures to the painting. Daniel places a cardboard tube on the desk. Bastaldi removes the painting from the tube, handling it without interest, as if it were a mere object to be sold. He opens a desk drawer, takes out several stacks of cash, and hands them to Daniel. As he does, the groaning sound is heard again.
related_events: Daniel presents the painting to Bastaldi
Bastaldi pays Daniel for the painting

name: Bastaldi Reveals the Man in the Closet
description: A muffled groaning sound interrupts the room. Bastaldi, annoyed, gets up and walks to a closet. He opens the doors to reveal a man in his underwear, his wrists tied behind his back, a piece of tape over his mouth, and a wire noose around his neck forcing him to stand on his toes. The man looks at Bastaldi with pleading eyes and mumbles. Bastaldi warns him, 'One more sound out of you and I'm going to cut your fuckin' tongue out,' then shuts the closet door. Daniel stares at the closed closet and asks how long the man has been in there. Bastaldi pauses, unsure. Julien says it's Thursday. Bastaldi mutters that the week has flown by. He then explains that the man was trusted with a job but claimed to misplace a shipment—147 wide-screen TVs—which he says is impossible to lose.
related_events: Bastaldi reveals a bound man in a closet
Bastaldi threatens the bound man
Bastaldi explains the bound man's punishment
Daniel inquires about the bound man's detention duration
Julien identifies the current day as Thursday

name: Bastaldi Assigns the America Heist
description: Bastaldi asks Daniel if he and his crew speak English. Daniel confirms they do. Bastaldi places a photograph on the desk showing a middle-aged American couple, the Taylors from Chicago. He points to the diamond necklace around the woman’s neck. He tells them an acquaintance recently stopped working as the woman’s assistant and revealed the couple keeps all their jewelry in a safe inside their bedroom. Daniel hesitates, questioning the distance and their lack of familiarity with the city. Marcel interrupts, insisting the decision is not up for discussion. Bastaldi adds that the job comes with a two-million-euro payout. He announces they will leave the next day. Daniel, Julien, and Raymond exchange glances but say nothing. The room falls silent as the crew accepts the assignment.
related_events: Bastaldi confirms Daniel and his crew speak English
Bastaldi proposes a job in America to Daniel
Bastaldi reveals the location of the Taylors' safe
Bastaldi presents the Taylors' photo and targets their jewelry
Daniel questions the rationale and feasibility of the mission
Marcel enforces Bastaldi's order to proceed with the job
Bastaldi reveals the financial incentive for the job
Bastaldi confirms the departure date for the job
Team acknowledges lack of choice in accepting the job

name: Julien Proposes a Local Guide, Marcel Offers a Contact
description: Julien points out that they don’t know Chicago well and suggests they need someone with local knowledge to help with the job. Marcel says he knows the right person for the task.
related_events: Julien suggests recruiting a local guide for the mission
